2609.19093.title: Reporting Practice Matters: The Impact of Reference Choice on Chest X-ray Report Evaluation
2609.19093.paper_summary: Radiologists follow heterogeneous reporting practices. Two radiologists examining the same image and identifying the same clinical findings might nevertheless compose superficially distinct reports, varying in terminology, shorthand, formatting, and level of detail. These variations in reporting norms represent an under-appreciated obstacle in efforts to evaluate AI-based radiology report generation (RRG) models, where machine-generated reports are typically assessed based on their concordance with human-generated references. In this paper, we quantify the sensitivity of established evaluation metrics to variations in reporting practices, revealing impacts large enough to alter the rankings of models. We introduce a radiologist-informed taxonomy of variations in radiology reporting practice and a method (ReRef) that rewrites reference reports along the axes of our taxonomy while preserving clinical interpretation. For instance, when comparing the performance of nine RRG models on MIMIC-CXR using RadCliQ-v1, condensing the discussion of normal findings in the reference reports causes Libra to drop from first to second place while CheXOne rises from third to first. Our results suggest that many current metrics fail to decouple clinical interpretation from conformity to reporting practices and that choosing the ``right'' references that accurately reflect the desired reporting practices can be important in practice. To support future research, we release MIMIC-CXR-Ext-ReRef, a radiologist-validated dataset of 120 (original, alternative) reference report pairs derived from MIMIC-CXR.
2609.19093.paper_summary_zh: 放射科醫生遵循異質的報告實踐。兩位放射科醫生檢查同一影像並識別相同的臨床發現，然而他們可能仍然撰寫表面上不同的報告，這些報告在術語、簡寫、格式和細節程度上有所不同。這些報告規範的變異代表了一個被低估的障礙，對於評估基於人工智慧的放射報告生成（RRG）模型的努力來說，機器生成的報告通常是根據其與人類生成的參考報告的一致性來評估的。在本文中，我們量化了既定評估指標對報告實踐變異的敏感性，揭示出足以改變模型排名的影響。我們引入了一個基於放射科醫生的放射報告實踐變異分類法以及一種方法（ReRef），該方法在我們的分類法軸上重寫參考報告，同時保留臨床解釋。例如，當使用RadCliQ-v1比較九個RRG模型在MIMIC-CXR上的表現時，對參考報告中正常發現的討論進行簡化，導致Libra從第一名降至第二名，而CheXOne則從第三名上升至第一名。我們的結果表明，許多當前的指標未能將臨床解釋與報告實踐的遵循分開，並且選擇準確反映所需報告實踐的“正確”參考在實踐中可能是重要的。為了支持未來的研究，我們發布了MIMIC-CXR-Ext-ReRef，這是一個經過放射科醫生驗證的數據集，包含120對（原始、替代）參考報告對，來源於MIMIC-CXR。
